title: a copybook numbered by one in columns 1-6 whose 88-level VALUES list of six-digit codes runs over three lines is still filed as a compiler listing

checks.sql: SELECT kind FROM member WHERE name='XQNAIC1'
SELECT parse_status FROM member WHERE name='XQPGM16'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pfield f JOIN program p ON p.id=f.program_id WHERE p.program_id='XQPGM16' AND f.name='XQ-NAICS1-DESC'
